content: Agent memory degradation: constraint compliance dropped 73%->33% between turn 5 and 16 without mitigation; stale facts stay indexed beside new ones and poison reasoning; memory poisoning via untrusted docs/webpages injecting false facts that act as persistent backdoors. Production memory needs: expiration/TTL policies, deduplication, contradiction detection, per-source provenance and confidence scores, input validation before write, separation of trusted vs untrusted memory.
